name: Payment Processing & Checkout Gateway
description: Secure payment orchestrator supporting Payment Intents, credit cards, Apple Pay/Google Pay, webhook signature verification, and automated refund management.

clarifying_questions.question: Checkout integration mode?
options: Stripe Hosted Checkout (Simplest, fully PCI compliant)
Custom UI with Stripe Elements / Payment Element
clarifying_questions.impacts: Determines frontend integration method and webhook handlers

clarifying_questions.question: Automated refund workflow?
options: Partial & full refunds with ledger tracking
clarifying_questions.impacts: Adds refunds table and balance reconciliation

known_constraints.pci_compliance_level: SAQ-A (no raw card data touches application server)

known_failure_modes: Failing to verify webhook cryptographic signature allowing forged payment success notifications
Missing idempotency keys resulting in double charges on network reconnects
Storing raw credit card numbers violating PCI-DSS compliance requirements
